summary: You take the project-based core (DESIGN 301, 341, 360R), DESIGN 231, 3 units each of design ethics (DATASCI 294D counts only at 3 units or more), leadership, visualization and applied design (courses of 3 units or more), the DESIGN 361A-C thesis sequence, one Methods track of at least 8 units, and a Domain of at least 8 units planned with your advisor, which you move in by hand. Every course must be taken for a letter grade when one is offered, and only courses numbered 100 or above count toward the 51 units. Other d.school project courses your advisor approves for Applied Design, and independent study approved by petition, are moved in by hand; you also check the 3.0 GPA by hand.
